name: Example JSON Connector
description: Developer example: analyzes and migrates a local JSON dataset directory (users, orders, order_items) through the full Migration Center pipeline. Proves the Connector SDK is provider-agnostic.
author: Backend Control Plane (first-party)

ui.setup_instructions: Point dataset_path at a directory of JSON files (one collection per file: <name>.json containing a JSON array of objects). The connector infers fields, primary keys and relationships by convention, then feeds the standard analysis → plan → migrate → validate pipeline.
